components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Any non-digit characters are
            stripped on create; exactly 10 digits must remain.
          type: string

All tests pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`). Here's what I changed.

## Summary

Consolidated the three separate duplicate checks into one derived `identityKey`.

**`identityKey` = `normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + householdId`** — rejection with 409 now happens only when a new owner's *whole* key matches an existing owner's.

### Changes

1. **`util/IdentityKeys.java`** (new) — a small, cohesive helper: `of(Owner)` derives the key (telephone is already stored E.164-normalized; missing email/householdId become empty segments) and `isDuplicate(...)` compares whole keys.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — replaced the three `if` blocks (telephone `anyMatch`, `EmailDuplicates.isDuplicate`, `!sharesHousehold && Households.isDuplicate`) with a single `IdentityKeys.isDuplicate` check, moving the existing `setHouseholdId` call above it so the household segment is part of the candidate's key.

3. **`OwnerMapper`** — one `@Mapping` expression populates `identityKey` on every owner response via `IdentityKeys.of(owner)` (single source of truth, no per-endpoint wiring).

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `identityKey` property to the `Owner` schema so the generated DTO exposes it.

### Behaviour change confirmed
Because the telephone is in the key, two members of the same household (same `householdId`) with different telephones now have different keys and are both allowed — only an exact full-key match is a duplicate.

### Structural-impact notes
The behaviour lives in a new small class with near-zero surrounding complexity, so the only edit inside the large controller is a net **reduction** — three branches collapsed to one — rather than growth. The mapper edit is a single annotation on a CC-1 method. No existing method or class grew in complexity.
